title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager (Solutions Architects)
description_html:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

As the Sales Strategy & Operations Manager for Baseten’s Solutions Architecture organization, you’ll be the day-to-day strategy and operations partner to our Head of Solutions Architecture and the SA managers who report to them. You’ll give them the analysis and operating support to run the SA org, and turn their priorities into the plans, capacity models, and operating cadence the team runs on.

Our Solutions Architects are central to how Baseten wins and grows. Revenue is consumption-based, so a deal isn’t done at signature. It grows as customers get workloads into production and scale them. SAs drive that at every stage: technical evaluations and POCs, onboarding, and the optimization work that expands usage inside existing accounts. Capacity planning, coverage, and impact measurement all have to reflect that. You’ll sit on the Revenue Strategy & Operations team and work closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Comp, Enablement, and GTM Engineering. You’ll own the SA org’s numbers, the reviews that inspect them, and the processes and systems that keep them reliable.



WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Operating cadence: Run the reviews that show SA leaders where SA time goes and what it delivers.

 - Capacity and coverage: Build the models behind SA headcount and how SAs are allocated across segments and accounts.

 - SA analytics: Measure SA engagement, technical win rates, and impact on consumption growth.

 - Process and systems: Build the SA engagement model into our systems.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Business partnership
   
   - Partner with our Head of Solutions Architecture and SA managers as the strategy and ops lead for the org
   
   - Run SA MBRs and QBRs that give leaders a shared view of the business, drive decisions, and assign owners
   
   - Translate SA priorities into plans with clear owners and deadlines, and track them to completion

 - Planning and capacity
   
   - Run annual and in-year SA planning, including the headcount and coverage models behind it, in partnership with RevOps, Sales leadership, and Finance
   
   - Work with Comp to implement SA variable compensation

 - Analytics
   
   - Own SA analytics: utilization, engagement by segment and stage, technical win rates, POC conversion, and post-sale consumption ramp
   
   - Inspect SA-engaged pipeline and surface technical risk on key deals early

 - Process and systems
   
   - Build the SA engagement model into Salesforce and get SA managers onboarded onto it



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 5 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations, BizOps, FP&A, or management consulting, ideally including time partnering directly with sales or technical pre-sales leaders

 - Experience running business review cadences (weekly pipeline reviews, MBRs, QBRs) for a sales, SA, or customer-facing technical team

 - Hands-on experience with capacity planning: building headcount, coverage-ratio, or resource allocation models

 - Strong analytical skills: you build your own models in spreadsheets and pull your own data from Salesforce, BI tools, or directly from a data warehouse. You write SQL and don’t just rely on Claude.

 - Working knowledge of Salesforce and how pre-sales engagement fits into sales process design (stages, exit criteria, technical validation)

 - Clear, structured communication: you turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it to sales and technical leaders

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and pace; you build the process rather than wait for one



NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience supporting Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Consulting orgs

 - Experience with consumption or usage-based revenue (cloud, API, or infrastructure businesses)

 - Experience measuring the impact of pre-sales or post-sale technical teams on revenue outcomes

 - Experience implementing or administering variable compensation plans for technical roles

 - Exposure to AI/ML infrastructure or developer-focused products



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).
$185K – $235K • Offers Equity

title: Staff Solutions Architect, Enterprise
description_html:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Staff Solutions Architect is Temporal's primary customer-facing technical leader within the Enterprise team, with a focus on the Western region US. In this crucial role, you’ll work directly with prospects and customers, guiding them in understanding the suitability of their applications for Temporal’s platform and showcasing the technical advantages of our cloud service. Your contribution is vital in positioning Temporal against alternative technologies, helping customer engineering teams expand production applications using Temporal, and owning the technical relationship with key decision-makers. Your role is integral to our success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Collaborate with prospects to determine if their applications fit Temporal’s platform well.

 - Educate customers and prospects on the technical benefits and limitations of Temporal’s platform and cloud service.

 - Position Temporal as a leading solution against competing technologies and architectural patterns.

 - Foster an environment within customer engineering organizations to increase the adoption and expansion of Temporal in production environments.

 - Partner closely with Account Executives to develop and execute comprehensive account plans, including identifying additional use cases in customer accounts.

 - Manage and nurture relationships with technical decision-makers at customer organizations to ensure they fully leverage Temporal’s capabilities and establish yourself as a Trusted Advisor.

 - Travel expected to be 25-50%.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Reside in the Pacific Time Zone, with Seattle, San Francisco, Portland, and Los Angeles preferred.

 - Exceptional technical communication skills, including presenting, whiteboarding, and writing.

 - Deep understanding of distributed system technologies, design principles, and best practices.

 - Proficiency in building application prototypes and providing design, development, build, and deployment guidance using one or more of Temporal’s supported languages: Java, Golang, TypeScript, Python, C# or PHP.

 - Firm grasp of operational considerations in production environments, such as security, reliability, performance, cost management, and operations.

 - Ability to provide insightful advice on architectural topics, including application patterns and platform architectures.

 - Experience with at least one major cloud provider and familiarity with commonly used application development and production services.

 - Serve as a strategic technical advisor to Sales Account Executives, assisting with scoping and sizing opportunities and offering guidance on technical fit and challenges.

Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Temporal Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.
$168K – $220K • Offers Equity • $72K – $94.5K Commission

description_html:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage.

As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production.

Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure.

This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK

 - Integrate networked block storage into our Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration

 - Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network

 - Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification

 - Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors can't degrade other tenants

 - Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability to hold the system to them

 - Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching

 - Keep the platform portable across AWS, other clouds, and bare-metal/colo

 - Write design docs, mentor engineers, and work closely with the Compute, Branching, Postgres, and Multicloud teams

 - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews

 - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU




MUST HAVE:

 - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and operating storage systems in production

 - Have built or operated distributed or software-defined block storage (for example Ceph RBD, Lightbits, Simplyblock, Portworx, LINSTOR/DRBD, or an in-house system)

 - Have hands-on experience with NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, including targets, initiators, multipath, and failover behavior

 - Have a deep understanding of Linux storage internals: the block layer, io_uring, page cache, O_DIRECT and fsync semantics, filesystems, and device-mapper

 - Write strong systems code in Go, plus C, C++, or Rust

 - Measure performance rigorously with fio, pgbench, eBPF, and perf, and can explain latency down to its individual components

 - Understand durability tradeoffs between replication, erasure coding, and consistency under failure

 - Have led technical direction on a complex system: design docs, tradeoffs, and bringing others along

 - Have experience with Kubernetes controllers and/or CSI drivers

 - Have been on call for large production systems

 - Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams


NICE TO HAVE:

 - SPDK development experience

 - RDMA/RoCE experience

 - Experience implementing block-level snapshots, thin provisioning, or copy-on-write cloning

 - Postgres internals knowledge (WAL, buffer manager, checkpointer), or familiarity with OrioleDB

 - Experience with AWS networking and instance storage at scale (ENA, placement, bandwidth limits)

 - Experience running storage on bare metal or in colo

 - Contributions to open source storage projects or the Linux kernel storage stack


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
